1.o: خلف باب واسع من الجليد في شمالي وستيروس هناك شيء يحدث. تتلقى عائلة ستارك التي من وينترفيل زيارة من العائلة المالكة، بينما يشكل أمير عائلة تارغارين المنفي تحالفاً جديداً للسيطرة على العرش من جديد.

2.o: تنطلق رحلة محفوفة بالمخاطر، وتبدأ خطوات جديدة تغيّر مسارات بعض الشخصيات

3.o: التوتر يزداد في العاصمة، بينما تبدأ التحديات الحقيقية خلف الجدار

4.o: تُكشف طبقات من الواقع القاسي، ويظهر أن لكل شخص مكان في هذا العالم المضطرب

5.o: الخصومات القديمة تبدأ بالاشتعال، والصراعات تتخذ طابعًا أكثر جدية

6.o: الكبرياء يقود إلى مصير مفاجئ، وقرارات جديدة تُتخذ في غياب السلطة

7.o: لعبة السلطة تصل إلى مرحلة حاسمة، والتردد لم يعد خيارًا

8.o: المواجهات تشتعل في أكثر من مكان، والاضطرابات تمتد إلى ما هو أبعد من العاصمة

9.o: الجميع في حالة ترقّب، حيث تقود الأحداث إلى مفترق طرق مصيري

10.o: يولد فجر جديد من الرماد، وتتغير موازين القوة في لحظة فارقة

1.o: يستمر ستارك بحربه ضد الـ لانسترز، ويصل تايرون لإنقاذ جوفري من التهديدات القديمة والجديدة، ويبحث الـ دانيريز عن الحلفاء والمياه في الـ ريد وايست ويختبئ جون سنو ونايتس ووتش خلف الجدار.

2.o: يحقق تايرون العدالة بعد مجرزة كبيرة في العاصمة، وتشارك إيرا، نايتس ووتش سراً في طريقهما إلى الشمال، ويعود المستكشف الذي أرسله داني بأخبار مزعجة ويعود ثيون غراجوي إلى آيرون آيلاندز.

3.t: What Is Dead May Never Die
3.ar: ما مات قد لا يموت أبداً
3.o: يخطط تايرون للتحالفات من خلال وعد الزواج، وتصل كاتلين إلى ستورملاندز لعقد تحالفها الخاص، ويخطط بالون غراجوي لاستراتيجية الهجوم ويحاول لوين فك لغز أحلام بران.

4.o: تتوسل كاتلين إلى الـ ستانيز والـ رينلي للاتحاد في وجه الـ لانسترز وتعثر داني على حليفها خارج أبواب الخلاص وتلقي ميليسندري بظلالها على الـ ستورملاندز.

5.o: تنتهي المنافسة بين الـ باراثيون، مما يجبر كاتلين على الهرب وليتلفينغر على التصرف. يعلم تاريون بسلاح سيرسي السري، تقبض آريا ديناً لم تكن تعرف به

6.t: The Old Gods and the New
6.o: يكمل ثيون خطته الجهنمية، ويبعد الـ لانسترز ميرسيلا عن الخطر في الوقت المناسب. كما تلتقي آريا بزائر غريب يشكل مفاجأة لها، وتقسم داني على استرجاع ما سلب منها بينما تعطي مورين الفرصة لـ جون حتى يثبت نفسه لها.

7.o: يلتقي جيمي بقريب له من العائلة، ويتلقى داني دعوة لزيارة قلعة هاوس أوف ذا أنداينغ، بينما يقود ثيون فريق بحث، ويضل جون طريقه في الصحراء، كما تقدم سيرسي النصيحة لـ سانسا.

8.o: يستقبل ثيون أحد الزوار ويحاصر قلعة وينترفيل، وتسترجع آريا دينها مع جاكين بطريقة تثير استياءه. كما تتم خيانة روب، ويتجاهل داني نصيحة جورا، بينما يصل كل من ستانس ودافوس إلى وجهتهم.

9.o: يقاتل تايرون والـ لانسترز من أجل البقاء على قيد الحياة، عندما يقوم أسطول ستانيس بمهاجمة عملية إنزال جيش الملك على الشاطئ.

10.o: يستفيق تايرون على عالم جديد، ويكافىء جيوفري رعيته، كما يحرض ثيون رجاله على التحرك بينما يعرض ليوين النصيحة، وتقوم براين بإسكات جيمي، وتحصل آريا على هدية من جاكين، ويثبت جون نفسه لـ كورين.

1.o: يتم إحضار جون أمام مانس رايدير، الملك خلف الجدار، في حين يتراجع الناجون من (نايتس ووتش) جنوبا. يطلب تيريون مكافأته، يعرض ليتلفينغر على سانسا طريقة للخروج، وتقيم سيرسي وليمة عشاء للعائلة المالكة.

2.o: تواجه آريا براذرهود وذاوت بانرز، في حين يواجه أخوها بران مجموعة غامضة من الأتباع في الجانب الآخر من العالم. يواصل جيمي وبراين رحلتهما إلى العاصمة، في حين العاصمة نفسها ترحب بملكة العرش المشهورة.

3.o: يتم تنصيب تيريون سيد العملة الجديد. يتم إرسال جون سنو مع مجموعة من المجتاحين لرفع الجدار، في حين يعقد دينيريس اتفاقا من أجل جميع العبيد في آستابور. يقنع جيمي خاطفيه ضد كل الجرائم في بريين.

4.t: And Now His Watch Is Ended
4.o: يحاول جيمي التأقلم من وضعه الجديد. يتآمر فاريز مع ملكة ثورنز. تتصعد الأمور مع نايتس ووتش في كراستيرز كيب. يلتقي آريا وجيندري بقائد براذرهود وذاوت بانيرز، بينما ينتهي دينيريز من إتفاقية أنسوليد.

5.o: تكتشف عائلة لانيستر خطة عائلة تيريل لتزويج سانسا ستارك من لوراس تيريل. في ريفيرلاند، يهزم ذا هاوند اللورد بيريك في المحاكمة ويتم إطلاقه. يناضل جون سنو لكسب ثقة ذا وايلدينغز بينما يخفي المعلومات الحاسمة.

6.o: يخطط تيوين لإتحادات إستراتيجية لـ لانسترز. تقوم ميليساندر بزيارة لـ ريفرلاندز. يتوصل روب لحل لإصلاح تحالفه مع هاوس فراي. يقرر روز بولتون ماذا سيفعل مع جيمي لانيستر، بينما يواجه جون، يغريت وذا وايلدينغز مهمة تسلق شاقة.

7.t: The Bear and the Maiden Fair
7.o: تتبادل دينيريز الهدايا مع سيد عبيد من خارج يانكاي. وبينما تشعر فريتس بالقلق حول توقعاتها، تغضب شاي من حالة تيريون الجديدة. يستشير تايوين الملك، وتفشي ميليساندر بسر لجيندري. وفي هذه الأثناء، تواجه بريين عدو لدود في هارينهال.

8.o: تستضيف أرض الملك حفل زفاف، ويمضي تيريون وسانسا الليل سوية. تقابل دينيريز جيندري، الإبن غي الشرعي لتيتان. يطلب دافوس دليلا من ميليساندرا، في حين يلتقي سام وجيلي رجلا كبيرا في رحلتهما إلى الحائط وكاسل بلاك.

9.o: يلتقي إدمور بعروسه بينما يتحضّر منزل تالي ليتحالف مع منزل فري. وفي هذه الأثناء، يواجه جون أصعب امتحان في حياته، يجد بران أن لديه هدية جديدة، ويناقش داريو وجوراه استراتيجيات الإستيلاء على يانكي.

10.o: يقوم جوفري بتحدي تيوين. يروي بران قصة شبح. في دراغونستون، تأتي الرحمة من جهات غريبة. تنتظر داينيريز لترى ما إذا كانت هي فاتحة أم محررة.

1.o: يرحب تيريون بضيف في أرض الملك بينما هم في كاسل بلاك، ويجد جون سنو أنه غير مرحب بوجوده. داني متوجه نحو ميرين، الأم لكل مدن العبيد. تتصادف أريا مع صديق قديم.

2.o: يقوم تايرون بمساعدة جيمي. يستضيف جوفري ومارغري ضيوفا على الفطور. في دراغونستون، يفقد ستانيس صبره مع دافوس. يجد رامسي هدفا من أجل حيوانه المدلل. شمال الحائط، يرى بران أين يجب عليهم الذهاب.

3.o: يفكر تيريون بخياراته بينما يمد تايوين يد السلام. يدرك سام أن كاسل بلاك ليست بأمان، ويقترح جون خطة جريئة. يقوم ذا هاوند بإخبار آريا عن حقيقة الأمور، وتختار داني بطلها.

4.o: يوازن داني بين العدالة والرحمة. يكلف جيمي بريين بصيانة شرفه. يقوم جون بتأمين المتطوعين، في حين يعثر بران، جوجينن ميرا وهودر على مأوى.

5.o: يبدأ جون بمهمة جديدة في حين يفكر سيرسي وتايوين بالخطوة القادمة نحو العرش.

6.t: The Laws of Gods and Men
6.o: ينطلق ستانيس ودافوس من دراغونستون باستراتيجية جديدة. تلتقي دينيريز مع بعض المتوسلين. في أرض الملك، يتواجه تيريون مع والده تيوين في غرفة العرش.

7.o: ينتقي تيريون حليفا غير متوقع، في حين يتوسل داريو لـ دينيريز لتسمح له بأن يفعل الشيء الذي يعرف فعله بأفضل طريقة. لا يستمع أحد لتحذيرات جون بشأن ضعف الجدار، في حين تتبع بريين طريقة جديدة بينما تستمر بمهمتها مع بود لتعقب فتيات الـ ستارك.

8.o: يتقرر مصير تيريون بينما يقف بطله أوبيرين مارتيل ضد غريغور (ذا ماونتن) كليغين. تستقبل بلدة مول زوارا غير متوقعين، يحاول رامسي إثبات نفسه لوالده، ويتم التساؤل عن دوافع ليتلفينغر.

9.o: يواجه جون سنو ورجال نايتس ووتش أكبر تحدي لهم على الإطلاق بينما يحضرون للدفاع عن الحائط من هجوم مانس ريدر وجيشه الهمجي.

10.o: وصول أحدهم غير المتوقع من شمال الحائط يقلب كل الأمور، في حين تضطر دينيريز لمواجهة بعض الحقائق القاسية في ميرين. ومن ناحية أخرى، يعلم بران المزيد عن مصيره، ويرى تيريون الحقيقة في وضعه.

1.o: يتأقلم جيمي وسيرسي مع العالم من دون وجود تايون. يكشف فاريز عن مؤامرة لتيريون. تواجه دينيريز تهديدا جديدا لحكمها. جون عالق بين ملكين.

2.t: The House of Black and White
2.o: تصل آريا إلى برافوس. يتورط بود وبرايان في مشاكل على الطريق. تخشى سيرسي على سلامة ابنتها في دورن بينما تسعى إيلاريا ساند للإنتقام لمقتل أوبيرين. يقوم ستانيس بإغواء جون. ويحاول مستشار إغواء دينيريز.

3.o: في برافوس، ترى آريا الإله متعدد الوجوه. وفي أرض الملك، تستمتع الملكة مارجري بزوجها الجديد. يسير تيريون وفاريز على جسر لونغ بريدج في فولانتيس.

4.o: يصبح منضلو الإيمان أكثر عدوانية. يتوجه جيمي وبرون إلى الجنوب. يتعهد إيلاريا وأفاعي الرمال بالإنتقام.

5.o: تتخذ دينيريز قرارا صعبا في ميرين. يطلب جون المساعدة من حليف غير متوقع. تبحث بريين عن سانسا. يبقى ثيون تحت سيطرة رامساي.

6.ar: غير منحنٍ، غير منكسر، غير مهزوم
6.o: يدخل جوراه وتيريون في عالم تجارة الرقيق. يضع تريستين وميرسيلا الخطط. يصل جيمي وبرون إلى وجهتهما. تقوم أفاعي الرمال بالهجوم.

7.o: يستعد جون للصراع. تحاول سانسا التحدث مع ثيون. تنتظر بريين إشارة. يبقى ستانيس عنيدا. يحاول جيمي التواصل مع العائلة.

8.o: تحرز أريا تقدما في تدريبها. تواجه سانسا صديقا قديما. سيرسي تعاني. ويسافر جون.

9.o: يواجه ستانيس قرارا مقلقا. يعود جون إلى ذا وول. يزور ميس آيرون بانك. تواجه آريا شخصا من ماضيها. تشرف دينيريز على مضض على احتفال تقليدي للألعاب الرياضية.

10.o: ستانيس يستمر قدما. دينيريز محاطة بالغرباء. تسعى سيرسي للمغفرة. جون في وسط تحدي.

1.o: في كاسل بلاك، يدافع ثرون عن خيانته بينما يدافع إد ودافوس عن أنفسهما. وفي مكان آخر، تحاول سانسا وثيون تحدي البرد ومن يقومون بمطاردتهما، بينما ترى سيرسي ابنتها مجددا.

2.o: يتدرب بران مع ثري آيد رافن، وفي كينغز لاندينغ، يقدم جيمي النصيحة لـ تومين، ويطلب تايرون الحصول على أخبار جيدة، لكن يبدو أنه سيتوجب عليه فعلها بنفسه. وفي كاسل بلاك، تدعم مجموعة نايتس ووتش ثورن، يقترح رامزي بولتون خطة، بينما يمعن بالون غريجوي النظر في عروض أخرى.

3.o: تلتقي دينيريس بمستقبلها بينما يلتقي بران بالماضي، يواجه تومين هاي سبارو، تتدرب آريا لكي تكون نو وان، بينما يعثر فاريس على إجابة ويحصل رامسي على هدية.

4.o: يبرم تيريون صفقة. وينخرط جوراه وداريو بمهمة صعبة. ويحاول كل من جايمي وكيرسي تحسين وضعهما.

5.o: يسعى تايرون وراء حليف غريب، يكتشف بران الكثير من الأمور، برين تنطلق في مهمة، بينما تُمنح آريا فرصة لإثبات نفسها.

6.o: يعود عدو قديم إلى مشهد الأحداث، وتلتقي جيلي بعائلة سام، بينما تواجه آريا خيارا صعبا، ويقف جيمي في وجه هاي سبارو.

7.o: يوجه هاي سبارو أنظاره نحو هدف آخر، ويواجه جيمي بطلا، بينما تضع آريا خطة، ويتم تذكر الشمال.

8.o: بينما يزن جيمي خياراته، تجيب سيرسي عن طلب ما، وتؤتي خطط تايرون ثمارها، فيما تواجه آريا اختبارا جديدا.

9.o: يطالب مبعوثو تجار الرقيق بشروط الاستسلام في ميرين، رامزي يخاطر في الدفاع عن وينترفيل

10.o: الحلقة الأخيرة: تواجه سيرسي محاكمتها.

1.o: ينظم جون سنو الدفاع عن الشمال. سيرسي يحاول موازنة الاحتمالات. سامويل يكتشف معلومات هامة. يعود دينيريس إلى المنزل.

2.o: تتلقى داينريس زائراً غير متوقع؛ جون يواجه ثورة. يخاطر سام بحياته المهنية والخاصة. يخطط تيريون لغزو ويستيروس

3.o: يعقد دينريز جسلة محاكمة، ويعيد كريسي هدية، ويتعلم جايمي من أخطائه الشخصية.

4.o: تدفع عائلة لانسترز ديونها، توازن دينيرس بين الخيارات المطروحة أمامها، بينما تعود آريا إلى منزلها.

5.o: أحدث حلقات المسلسل الناجح والشهير.

6.o: يقوم جون والـ براذرهود بمطاردة الموتى. تواجه أريا سانسا. ويفكر تيريون في المستقبل.

7.o: تجلس سيرسي على العرش الحديدي. يبحر دينيريس عبر نارو سي، يصبح جون سنو الملك في الشمال. ويصل موسم الشتاء أخيراً.

1.o: بعد وصولهم إلى وينترفيل، يكافح جون سنو والـ دانيريز لتوحيد الشمال المنقسم على ذاته.

2.t: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
2.o: يناقش جيمي قضيته أمام جمهور مشكك.

3.o: تتطلع آريا إلى إثبات قيمتها كمقاتلة حقيقية.

4.o: في أعقاب نصر باهظ الثمن، يوجه جون ودينيريس أنظارهما صوب الجنوب بينما يبصر تايريون تسويةً قد تنقذ أرواحاً لا حصر لها.

5.o: بينما يلوح صراع ملحمي في الأفق في مملكة كينغز لاندينغ، تقوم دينيريس وسيرسي بتقييم الخيارات المتاحة.

6.o: لقد حُدد مصير الممالك السبع الحتمي في هذه الحلقة الأخيرة من مسلسل غيم أوف ثرونز.

1.o: It's his first day at SAI Corporation, and Tsukasa Mizugaki is excited. After a recomendation from his father, Tsukasa scores a role in the terminal service department. He is tasked to pair up with Isla, a female 'Giftia' android. Their job is to recover other Giftias that are close to expiring.

2.o: Tsukasa and Isla's teamwork hasn't been off to a good start. They are finding themselves failing at the easiest tasks. But who is letting the team down?

3.o: Tsukasa and Isla have to share an apartment, to help their relationship as a team grow. However at home, Isla is a very quiet and distant person. How can Tsukasa get through to her?

4.t: I Just Don't Know How to Smile
4.o: Tsukasa and Isla have to handle a delicate case in which an orphaned child has to come to grips with losing the only family he has left – his Giftia.

5.t: The Promise I Wanted to Keep
5.o: Tsukasa and Isla have to handle a delicate case in which an orphaned child has to come to grips with losing the only family he has left – his Giftia.

6.t: Welcome Home the Both of Us
6.o: Tsukasa has to deal with his emotions after the tragic events of his last Giftia recovery. However he seems to be taking things rather well.

7.t: How to Properly Ask Her Out
7.o: The time has finally come, Tsukasa is going to ask Isla out on a date. Just how he is going to accomplish that, no one knows.

8.o: Tsukasa works on a new case with an efficient marksman, who happens to be one of Eru's old friends. Tsukasa questions whether or not recycled Giftias can regain their old memories.

9.o: The entire office is shocked after Isla turned down Tsukasa's confession. Isla admits that she isn't sure of her own feelings, so Michiru suggests that the pair should spend some time apart.

10.o: After Kazuki dissolves the partnership between Isla and Tsukasa, each teams up with someone new. As they take on separate cases, they both have the time to reflect on their unique bond.

11.o: Now that Isla and Tsukasa are officially a couple, they are more nervous around one another than normal. They seek advice from their coworkers on how to deal with their new relationship jitters.

12.o: Tsukasa and Isla get showered with date ideas from all their colleagues. They decide to take a break from work and spend some time together, to create some memories.

13.t: I Hope One Day You'll Be Reunited
13.o: Tsukasa and Isla get showered with date ideas from all their colleagues. They decide to take a break from work and spend some time together, to create some memories.

1.o: A village is tormented by a Yoma, which is a demon that has disguised itself as a human it has eaten. As a last resort the Chief of the village has ask for the help from a Claymore, who are feared as they are half human, half Yoma. 1.o: Experience the power of the blue whale - the largest mammal ever to grace our planet. Learn how the sun and moon help control and tame the ocean. Travel far and wide - from the Eastern Pacific to Alaska, from the Bering Sea to the shores of Southern California - and begin to understand the complexity and power of our oceans.

2.o: A place of mountain ranges, perpetual night, pressures extremes and cold... and the weirdest life forms on our planet. Dive into the depths of the ocean, an eerie world where predators with teeth so large they can't even close their mouths, chase bio-luminescent creatures of the deep. Discover the spectacular smoking chimneys of the hydrothermal vents. Go deeper down than you have ever been...

3.o: In the immense space of the open ocean the sea bed is a staggering five miles below the surface and the nearest island is over 300 miles away. Yet here live many of the most spectacular predators in the ocean. Marvel as you experience ruthless and beautiful battles between hunter and prey.

4.o: An environment where only the toughest survive, the Arctic and Antarctic are unrelenting habitats. Only in spring does life begin again. Plankton blooms and feeds fast hordes of migrating fish, walruses rake the seabed for clams, and minke and humpback whales gorge themselves on gigantic swarms of krill. But it is a brief spring feast - the ice soon returns and pushes life back into the ocean.

5.o: As the days grow longer, billions of microscopic plankton bloom under the blazing sun. Here in the temperate seas, three-ton basking sharks graze among forests of giant kelp - the fastest growing plant in the world. The forests harbor thousands of other animals, including sea otters, brilliantly colored anemones, squid, and exquisite leafy dragons. But as the year wears on, storms rage in the icy sea... a desperate challenge for the animals that remain.

6.o: Bathed in bright sunlight and warm clear water, the coral reef is a rich oasis of life - the rainforest of the sea. Bizarrely adorned harlequin shrimp carry off a starfish several times their size, while haunting songs reverberate around the reef, heralding the arrival of humpback whales. Shimmering schools of brightly colored fish battle for territory in this competitive world where you have to stand out to survive.

7.o: The sun and moon move billions of tons of water with every turn of the tide. The strongest tides empty entire bays, smash trees on riverbanks, and strand sea creatures on suddenly dry land. Weaker tides control the movements of huge numbers of fish, coaxing stingrays though astounding underwater arches. And as the water recedes, the tide can create unbelievable landscapes - like a sparkling world of salt crystals inhabited only by tiny shrimp and bright pink flamingos.

8.o: From rocky cliffs to gentle dunes, the coasts are always changing. Day in and day out, they are battered by crashing waves. Seabirds come here by the thousands to nest, while baby turtles hatch and race to the sea, pursued by hungry predators. Young sea lion pups are born and play on the sand - until a killer whale attacks, crashing in on the surf. But when breeding season is over, life returns to the sea and the shores are empty once again.

17.o: It's revealed where the book has been kept but no one knows how to open the time portal. All the characters reunite but is there enough time left?

18.o: Everyone wants to open the time portal before it's too late. The Big Bang theory suggests the end may as well be the beginning. Jett has an idea!

19.o: Hochi and Sky decide to make the most of the remaining time while Jett reveals the secrets and inspirations behind the manga, "My Dear Warrior."

20.o: Finally, all things must come to an end. Sky grows up to be a changed adult. One thing has never changed: her love and longing for Hochi.

1.o: Sebastián leverages tickets to a Paul McCartney concert to flirt with a young secretary. But it's his ex-wife, Pilar, who still has him intrigued.

2.o: A comedy gig that Sebastián doesn't really want to do conflicts with a big soccer game, and the decision about what to do is full of significance.

3.o: Sebastián runs into his high school girlfriend after 30 years, and she's still holding a grudge because he kept their relationship a secret.

4.o: An old friend wants Sebastián to do a monologue at her elderly father's birthday gala. A reluctant Sebastián agrees, with baleful consequences.

5.o: When Sebastián learns about a friend's separation, he remembers years back when his ex, Pilar, tried to get him to break their intimate routines.

6.o: Sebastián's ineptness with the children threatens to upend a much needed day off for Pilar to try new things.

7.o: When Gastón, Sebastián's brother, shows up on his way to Madrid, Sebastián feels the urge to vent about how they relate to each other.

8.o: Before he leaves for Madrid, Gastón resists seeing family and insists he and Sebastián party together, even after his recent medical incident.

9.o: As Sebastián realizes he never wanted to separate from Pilar, she calls him urgently. But what she has to say is the last thing Sebastián expects.

10.o: Sebastián seems to be getting hit from all sides at once, but he'll have to make the decision on what might be the biggest potential change of all.

1.o: From farming to smuggling to sales, former CIA analyst Amaryllis Fox investigates cocaine's hugely profitable and disturbingly deadly business cycle.

2.o: Despite its potential therapeutic benefits, MDMA is pushed into the shadows where it — along with synthetic analogs — have become popular party drugs.

3.o: Fox travels to Kenya, where she speaks to people living and working on the front lines of one of the world's newest and most profitable heroin routes.

4.o: Meth's global menace infects Myanmar, where complex politics and history have made it Southeast Asia's ground zero for production and distribution.

5.o: Despite the legalization of pot in California, roughly 80% of the state's cannabis sales still occur on the black market. Fox examines why.

6.o: Fox explores how highly addictive oxycodone continues to cause unprecedented destruction across America and even pushes addicts toward heroin.

1.o: Jin Sook has three grown children, Eun Joo, Eun Hee, and Ji Woo. Her husband Sang Shik is a long-haul truck driver. If he isn’t out working, he’s hiking in the mountains. Jin Sook calls for a family meeting and declares to her kids that she wants to graduate from her marriage. Even with mixed responses from her kids, Jin Sook is determined to get her way.

2.o: Eun Hee feels flustered after she runs into Jong Min at her team dinner and does something she normally wouldn’t do. She goes to see Chan Hyuk and dumps all of her emotional baggage on him. Meanwhile, Sang Shik goes missing and the family file a missing persons report. He turns up in a hospital and doesn’t seem to recognize his kids at all.

3.o: Chan Hyuk rushes to Eun Hee’s office after getting a text about her new boss. He decides to coach Eun Hee’s relationship with him after seeing them together in person. Meanwhile, the 22-year-old Sang Shik goes home from the hospital and acts like a loving, doting husband. Jin Sook has a hard time getting used to this change.

4.o: Jin Sook goes with Sang Shik as he heads down to the Ulsan factory for work. When they get there, a young man named Young Shik appears, leaving both Jin Sook and Sang Shik feeling flustered. Meanwhile, Eun Joo and Eun Hee are shocked by the news that Sang Shik had tried to commit suicide. Later on, Tae Hyung heads to New Zealand for a seminar.

5.o: Sang Shik and Jin Sook head south to find Young Shik, but he is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Eun Hee stays by Eun Joo’s side as she tries to make sense of Tae Hyung’s secret. Ji Woo drunkenly blurts out the secret about Eun Joo’s father to Chan Hyuk. Finally, Eun Joo goes to see her mother-in-law when she can’t reach Tae Hyung.

6.o: Eun Hee chases the trail of breadcrumbs left by Hyo Seok in order to find Tae Hyung. She ends up in Goheung, but she wonders whether her sad hunch will turn out to be true. Sang Shik lies that his memory is back, but he feels confused when he actually starts remembering bits and pieces of the past.

7.o: Chan Hyuk feels conflicted while watching Eun Hee trying so hard to fix everyone’s problems. Eun Hee keeps having unexpected feelings toward Chan Hyuk and struggles to keep her friendship him as just that and nothing more. Meanwhile, Eun Joo resentfully asks Jin Sook why she had to be so cold toward her and Sang Shik.

8.o: Eun Hee is surprised and uncomfortable with Ha Ra’s sudden appearance, but she can’t avoid the situation because of Gyung Ok. Jin Sook goes to see Sang Shik who is living out of his truck and sees a new side of him. Meanwhile, Eun Joo struggles to deal with her parents’ issues as well as Tae Hyung, and Eun Hee figures out something that she hopes isn’t true.

9.o: Eun Hee figures out Jin Sook’s secret from long ago. Jin Sook takes Eun Joo to the neighbourhood she grew up in and tells her the secret about her father. Meanwhile, Chan Hyuk has some friends come by and is reminded of what happened between him and Eun Hee in the past. Sang Shik regains his memory and calls for a family meeting.

10.o: Sang Shik declares to his family that he plans to take responsibility for Young Shik and his son and live with them. Hearing this leaves everyone feeling flustered. Meanwhile, Ha Ra meets with Eun Hee again and tells her what happened over the week Gun Joo took off from work. Later, Chan Hyuk gets a call from Eun Joo, asking to meet.

11.o: Sang Shik asks Jin Sook about Eun Joo’s biological father and discovers that he was mistaken the whole time. Meanwhile, Chan Hyuk goes to a driving school to finally get his driver’s license. Later on, Eun Joo calls Eun Hee to meet up at Golden Goose Media, since Ji Woo keeps ignoring her calls.

12.o: Eun Hee wants to know why Chan Hyuk is angry with her and they end up talking about old misunderstandings and resentments. Meanwhile, what Sang Shik thought was a thoughtful gesture only makes Eun Joo feel that he is treating her differently because she isn’t his biological child. Finally, Sang Shik and Jin Sook meet up for a real date.

13.o: Ji Woo asks Eun Hee why Chan Hyuk doesn’t have a driver’s license, but Eun Hee doesn’t seem to know much about him either. Gun Joo asks Chan Hyuk for an unusual favor, and Chan Hyuk gladly agrees. Later on, Chan Hyuk starts to tell Eun Hee about his family, and Eun Joo runs into an old colleague.

14.o: Eun Hee gets rid of relics from her past and decides to start fresh, while Jin Sook feels guilty about Eun Joo’s divorce. Meanwhile, Seo Young does some digging to find out about Ji Woo’s long-distance girlfriend, and Ji Woo rejects Chan Hyuk’s offer to become a full-time employee. Later on, Sang Shik goes to the hospital for surgery.

15.o: Jin Sook comforts Sang Shik who is worried about losing his memory again before he goes for surgery. Eun Joo and Eun Hee can’t face telling their parents about Ji Woo’s rash decision. As Jin Sook feels the absence of Sang Shik and Ji Woo in the house, she discovers Ji Woo’s letter to Eun Hee.

16.o: Jin Sook feels angry at her kids for hurting her and decides that she wants to spend some time alone travelling. While she is away, the rest of the family learn how big a void Jin Sook’s absence leaves, but everyone still learns to take care of themselves. After some valuable time apart, the family reunites.

1.o: Sally meets the demihuman Frau, who immediately joins her on her journey. After experiencing the discrimination that demihumans face at the hands of humans, Sally and Frau are arrested by Hawthorn, commander of the Knights of Rimdarl!

2.o: Sally wields her peach power against the high ogre Sett who is tearing through the Kingdom of Rimdarl. Meanwhile, Sett's companion, the high ogre Meki, encounters Mikoto. How will the peach fighters fare against the high ogres?!

3.o: Sumeragi holds a meeting to warn the other ogres of the path of destruction wrought by Mikoto. While the other ogres panic, the fighter Todoroki raises his doubts about Sumeragi's motivations... until Sumeragi reveals Meki's fate.

4.o: In a world where man-eating ogres run rampant and the people hide in walled-in cities, Sally, princess of the Aldarake Kingdom, longs to go on a journey and see life on the outside. But Sally's life will change forever when a traveler named Mikoto comes to the kingdom... followed by an army of ogres!

5.o: Sally and her companions arrive in a village plagued by vampire attacks... and demihuman discrimination. When Sally refuses, at Carrot's urging, to punish the humans for their treatment of Frau, Carrot decides to seek other aid... at the hands of the vampire himself!

6.o: Frau returns to life with the help of the angel Atla, but their form is temporarily changed. Meanwhile, Mikoto begins traveling with the amnesiac Millia (Hatsuki), when the two are confronted by a nameless mid ogre.

7.o: The Kingdom of Rimdarl is destroyed by Somenki's cannon, leaving Hawthorn adrift. He and Meki (now Carrot) join up with her, but in the next town they visit, Sally begins to wonder about the nature of prejudice.

8.o: As Sally makes her decision between Mikoto and Sumeragi, Todoroki and his companions attack, seeking revenge against the Peach Boy.

9.o: Kibitsu Mikoto, AKA Peach Boy, sails to Ogre Island and defeats the ogre leader... but the story isn't over. One day after, he meets Mikoto, a half-human, half-ogre child...

10.o: As Sally rushes to save her companions, Frau fights Basoo, and Carrot struggles to deal with her former ally, Shinki. Hawthorn is prepared to die to hold off Todoroki. Can someone save him in the nick of time?

11.o: Sally visits Winnie the Witch, and asks her to teach her magic. Just then, the heads of the elf and lizardfolk clans appear. Usually mortal enemies, they've come to ask Winnie a boon -- to free the giant ogre sealed in the forest!

12.o: During the battle with Juki, Sally declares that everyone present should try to make peace. Meanwhile, Sumeragi makes a case to Mikoto about coexistence between ogres and humans.

1.o: Almost two years after a devastating loss, the Duke of Castamar hosts a big party. An agoraphobic Clara is forced to prove herself at her new job.

2.o: When the king goes missing during the party, Diego and his friends search for him. Meanwhile, Clara makes an unexpected discovery she must keep secret.

3.o: Amelia has shocking news for Enrique. The queen asks Melquíades to covertly find an important document. A fire threatens Rosalia's future at Castamar.

4.o: Singer Carlo Broschi is invited to perform a concert at Castamar. Diego meets a young woman and Clara gets jealous. During the party, tragedy strikes.

5.o: Diego, feeling conflicted about his night with Amelia, turns to an old friend for advice. Clara's guilt engulfs her. Gabriel is distrustful of Enrique.

6.o: Diego and Amelia celebrate their news but Gabriel voices his suspicions. Sol waits for her wish to be fulfilled. Enrique remembers a failed plan.

7.o: When Clara is found unconscious, Diego insists on staying by her bedside, no matter the social implications. Amelia, however, won't be deterred.

8.o: Diego helps Clara search for evidence of her condemned father's innocence. Enrique plots to frame Francisco. Amelia asks Elisa for a favor.

9.o: Amelia faces a serious complication with her pregnancy and turns to an unexpected source for help. Alfredo searches for a missing Gabriel.

10.o: After a wounded Alfredo reports back to Castamar, Diego desperately looks for his brother. Úrsula is tormented by someone from her past.

11.o: Diego resorts to kidnapping in an attempt to find Enrique so he can seek vengeance. Amelia acts as Gabriel's caretaker and tries to lift his spirits.

12.o: The day of Diego and Amelia's wedding — and Clara's father's execution — brings multiple last-minute surprises for everyone at Castamar.

1.o: Ayako is an ambitious young police detective whose big break finally comes when she gets the chance to arrest a murder suspect single-handed. But before she can slap on the cuffs, their souls are switched and Ayako finds herself in the body of Haruto, a psychopathic serial killer!

2.o: Now Haruto offers Ayako a choice: either turn herself in to the police and spend her life behind bars or help him clear his name. Ayako has no choice but to choose the latter. On Haruto’s instructions, she removes evidence of Haruto’s crimes from his apartment before the police can search it.

3.o: Hideo, Ayako’s police buddy, figures out that her soul has been switched with Haruto’s. Ayako, in desperation, seeks Hideo’s help in stopping Haruto from killing again. Meanwhile, she learns of an ancient legend about the sun and the moon, and she heads to Amami Oshima island in search of a flower that she hopes can restore her soul to her own body. There, she finds an unexpected clue concerning Haruto.

4.o: Haruto commits another hideous murder. When she finds out, Ayako is horrified that her body has been used to take a human life. Later, Hideo tells her that he can no longer cooperate with her out of fear of Haruto, and she feels helpless to prevent another murder. Meanwhile, Mitsuo becomes suspicious and tracks down an eyewitness to the crime.

5.o: The more Ayako learns about Haruto, the less she understands him. From everything she hears, he’s far from being a psychotic serial killer. So is he covering up for someone? Or is he not the murderer after all? Meanwhile, details about the crimes and the police’s reasons for suspecting Haruto begin appearing on social media, and Haruto’s company becomes the target of a negative campaign. Since the police didn’t officially release the information, who leaked it?

6.o: Suspecting an old love letter in Haruto’s possession holds a clue to solving the case, Ayako investigates his past to find out who sent it. Meanwhile, Hideo is approached by a man arrested for gambling who wants to make a plea bargain in exchange for information. According to him, the timings of the murders all share something in common.

7.o: Why is Haruto searching through the unidentified bodies in the morgue for a man named Sakuya Azuma? Who is he and what has he got to do with the case? Ayako and Mitsuo are also frantically searching for the same answers. Later, Haruto’s father tells Ayako something surprising about Haruto’s past. Meanwhile, the body of a new victim is unexpectedly discovered.

8.o: While the police investigate the scene of another bizarre murder, Haruto heads back to the hospital where Sakuya has been taken. Ayako begins to suspect that Haruto’s estranged brother has something to do with the murders. Meanwhile, Mitsuo, who’s eager to be put back on the case, begins connecting the dots about Haruto and Sakuya’s relationship, and about Ayako.

9.o: After falling from an overpass, the state of Ayako’s and Haruto’s souls remains in doubt… Meanwhile, police close in on Haruto and his fraternal twin, Sakuya, as the prime suspects in the case. At that very moment, however, Sakuya is on his way to a remote island with Ayako’s roommate, Riku.

10.o: Haruto is arrested. Despite her promise to save him, Ayako can only stand by helplessly while Mitsuo begins his interrogation. Riku is also questioned by police after returning from his trip with Sakuya. Though worried about Ayako, Riku is conflicted about what he should do. With the police no closer to determining the serial killer’s identity, Ayako realizes she must take matters into her own hands.

1.o: It’s September 1963, and Voltaire High is getting ready for another school year. For the first time ever, this establishment will welcome girls: 11 of them to be exact, all freshmen. If the Principal is delighted with this experience, Vice-Principal Bellanger isn’t convinced. He and his wife Jeanne, the school nurse, will soon have to deal with the unforeseen excesses of coeducation.

2.o: Big day for Freshman Class 1: it’s their first Physical Education class, with its share of surprises for the girls. And it’s the class president election… It is also a trying day for Bellanger: it’s the day of his nephew’s disciplinary board hearing, and he needs to keep a close eye on the trials and tribulations of Miss Couret, the new English teacher, who is trying to fit in.

3.o: This week, the students will be pairing up to do an exposé. Simone is glad to see Jean-Pierre when working at Michèle’s, who hopes to finally get a good grade. Annick meets her mum’s new boyfriend, but is wary of him. The student-teacher soccer game is coming up, breaking with tradition this year as Bellanger is a referee and there is a woman on the field!

4.o: Bellanger is excited to be back in at school again after the Christmas break… But today, the boys are restless. It infuriates Michèle, who’d like to know what "makes you blind" and can’t stand being treated like a little girl. When the source of all this commotion is revealed in the middle of English class, Couret and Bellanger have to team up to deal with this disciplinary issue together.

5.o: Tonight, Jeanne, the school nurse, goes to the theater with Denise. There, she meets Irène, an actress who deeply moves her. On her way back, Denise crosses paths with Bellanger, who walks her home and confides in her about his love life. Meanwhile at the Courets’, they’re having a hard time understanding Camille’s sudden change in life: everything was going really well between her and Francis…

6.o: Annick is disgusted by the upcoming frog dissection, and suggests stealing the batrachians, in exchange for 1h of tutoring with her. The boys need nothing more to take on the challenge! "The VP’s niece" is again sidelined from the plans. Between two trips to the restroom because of sharp period pains, Simone tells Michèle she should show them she’s not a goody-two-shoes by stealing them herself.

7.o: It’s a good thing Laubrac’s there, because Michèle is very upset with Jean-Pierre and Simone. She hangs out at the student lounge where she tells everyone what she witnessed at the cinema and the rumors take off. The regional Latin contest is coming up for Jean-Pierre: he knows he can’t screw it up…

8.o: Michèle’s parents are worried she hasn’t come home yet. The Principal gives Bellanger an ultimatum: if Michèle did start the rumors about Jeanne, he wants to talk to her today. When Paul learns that she has eloped with his protégé, he goes looking for them. But in fact, he admires their boldness… The students improvise a surprise-party at Pichon’s to celebrate the end of the school year!

1.o: Director Choi's briefing about the mission leaves Song Ji-an displeased. Reaching the research station alone proves no easy feat for the crew.

2.o: The crew's initial findings are at odds with their knowledge of the research station. Split into threes, the members set out to look for the sample.

3.o: Ji-an's body cam captures a startling moment of life and death. Submerged in sweat, Gong Soo-chan shows worrisome signs of an unusual infection.

4.o: Han Yun-jae updates the director and gets access to a restricted area. The crew learns of the sample's powers and the true motive behind their mission.

5.o: Recalling her sister's encrypted message, Ji-an searches the database for Luna. A young intruder and a double-crosser emerge from the shadows.

6.o: E2, Ryu Tae-suk and the samples go missing. Seeing a familiar name on the intruder, Ji-an follows her down the vents for answers.

7.o: Ji-an opens a hard drive that chronicles Song Won-kyung's life and work on the station. Meanwhile, others uncover the remains of the experiment.

8.o: Racing against time as the research station falls under destruction, the surviving crew members decide on the fate of the mission — and their own.

1.o: While Dmitry assumes his post as the president and pushes for reforms, Goloborodko settles into his life in prison and runs into an old friend.

2.o: New leadership brings radical changes that upset the oligarchs. Goloborodko's team continues to advocate for his release from prison.

3.o: After the inauguration, Yuri and the newly appointed president arrange a summit with representatives from every Ukrainian republic.

1.o: As Harry shares the impact of a childhood in the public eye, he and Meghan reflect on the secret, early days of their unexpected romance.

2.o: In 2016, the relationship becomes public -- and public scrutiny begins.  Meghan remembers school, family life, acting and activism before Harry.

3.o: The couple's 2017 engagement sparks both cynicism and hope.  As Meghan grapples with royal protocols, tabloid headlines begin to involve her family.

4.o: Harry and Meghan's wedding is a resounding success.  But as their popularity grows, internal rifts and media coverage take a worrying toll.

5.o: After private correspondences with their families are leaked, the couple makes a crucial decision -- and ensuing online campaigns turn chilling.

6.o: The couple arrives in California, where a friend takes them in.  Amid painful losses and legal battles, Harry and Meghan being to forge their path ahead.

1.o: After a fall from grace, fiercely talented and award-winning investigative journalist Eileen Fitzgerald leaves her high-profile New York life behind to join a daily metro newspaper in Anchorage. Her journey to find both personal and professional redemption begins

2.o: When Roz and Eileen find a lead in Gloria's case, Eileen calls in a favor to help them track down the person of interest. Meanwhile, Claire investigates why beloved local restaurant Rita's is selling to a big corporation. After landing her first front page story, Yuna learns that success in journalism sometimes comes at a cost.

3.o: Eileen, Roz and Sylvie travel to Meade to learn more about a suspect in Gloria's case and connect with the local police chief, which proves to be more challenging than expected. When Austin learns about a political candidate's murky financial ties, Stanley must decide if they can publish with the newspaper's owner having endorsed the candidate.

4.o: It's the Alaska State Fair and The Daily Alaskan team is covering every angle of this beloved annual event, including Gabriel who is excited for his first assigned story. When his reporting leads him somewhere unexpected, he rises to the occasion with Eileen's support. Meanwhile, Eileen and Roz have very different weekends before reuniting to make more progress on their investigation.

5.t: I Have No Idea What You're Talking About, Eileen
5.o: When someone from Eileen's past comes to Alaska, she goes against orders, causing a frenetic scene which has some unexpected consequences. Meanwhile, Eileen and Roz gain a new lead on Gloria's case

6.t: You Can't Put a Price on a Life
6.o: When two local women go missing, Roz grows frustrated over the lack of equal attention both cases are receiving; and Stanley agrees to have the team write a comparison piece on the two missing girls. Meanwhile, Bob gives Roz and Eileen a lead on Gloria's case, and after they appear on local radio show “Concerned Citizens,” threats escalate to perilous new heights.

7.o: The stakes are high when Concerned Citizen targets Eileen at gunpoint and takes her hostage in the newsroom. As the clock ticks, the team races to help before it's too late.

8.t: Tell a Reporter Not to Do Something and Suddenly It's a Party
8.o: As the team grapples with the incident's aftermath, they support one another as the daily grind continues and bleak budgets loom for the paper. Meanwhile, new discoveries surrounding Gloria's death highlight leads that could reclassify the case.

9.o: When a new finding makes a familiar face the top suspect in Gloria Nanmac's case, Eileen and Roz hustle to report first. Meanwhile, Austin and Claire follow Conrad Pritchard's trail to figure out what he is really up to in Alaska.

10.o: While making progress on Gloria's case, both Eileen and Roz are offered new career opportunities, leaving them to consider what may lie beyond Alaska. Meanwhile, Bob steps out of his comfort zone, and Austin's custody agreement turns sour.

11.t: Most Reckless Thing I've Ever Done
11.o: With rumors of a new Alaskan newspaper swirling, the team investigates their competition and what it means for the future of local news. Meanwhile, Eileen and Roz listen to Gloria's final call and find their lead before an innocent man is put away.

1.t: When You're Lost in the Darkness
1.o: بعد عشرين عامًا من تفشي فطري يدمر الكوكب، يُكلف الناجون بمهمة قد تغير كل شيء

2.o: تبدأ الرحلة الحقيقية وسط أنقاض مدينة خطيرة مليئة بالمجهول

3.o: لمحة مؤثرة من الماضي تكشف كيف يمكن للإنسان أن يتشبث بالحياة وسط العزلة

4.o: تتعقد الرحلة مع دخول منطقة جديدة، حيث لا أحد يرحب بالغرباء

5.o: التحالف المؤقت هو السبيل الوحيد للنجاة من عالم لا يرحم

6.o: لقاء مرتقب يعيد ذكريات قديمة ويكشف عن قرارات مصيرية

7.o: رحلة إلى لحظة خاصة في الماضي تترك أثرًا لا يُنسى

8.o: في مواجهة الخطر، تُختبر قوة الإرادة والثقة في أصعب الظروف

9.o: تصل الرحلة إلى نهايتها، لكن القرار الأخير قد يغير كل شيء

1.o: بعد مرور خمس سنوات على الأحداث في سولت ليك سيتي، تكتشف إيلي البالغة من العمر 19 عامًا شيئًا جديدًا أثناء قيامها بدورية مع صديقتها المقرّبة دينا. وفي جاكسون هول، يسعى جول للحصول على المساعدة لإصلاح علاقته مع إيلي.

2.o: .خلال تشكل العاصفة في الجبال، يستعد سكان جاكسون هول للأسوأ وسط زيادة في مشاهدات المصابين. وفي هذه الأثناء، تدرس آبي خياراتها

3.o: بعد أن تشارك دينا معلومات حاسمة، تستعد إيلي لتقديم التماس إلى مجلس المدينة، بالرغم من صراعها مع جراحها العميقة. وفي أطراف سياتل، تحاول طائفة دينية الهروب من الحرب، مما يثير تساؤلات حول ما ينتظرهم في المستقبل.

4.o: .في عام 2018، واجهت منظمة فيدرا في سياتل عدواً غير متوقع. وبعد عشر سنوات، يجد كل من إيلي ودينا نفسيهما وسط معركة دموية بين سيرافيتس المتعصبة والميليشيا العنيفة

5.o: تكتشف جبهة تحرير (واشنطن) ‫اكتشافًا خطيرًا... وبتكلفة كبيرة. لاحقًا، يجب على إيلي أن تقرر ما إذا كانت ستواصل خطتها وتخاطر بوضع دينا في خطر، أم سوف تتخلى عن سعيها لتحقيق العدالة.

6.o: .يقوم جول بمفاجئة إيلي في عيد ميلادها. ومع استمرار اتساع الفجوة بينهما، تستعد إيلي لمواجهة حاسمة، بينما يتخذ جول قراراً صعباً أثناء دوريته

7.o: .إن رحلة بحث إيلي تقودها بعيداً عن أصدقائها نحو مواجهة مدمرة، و ذلك خلال استعداد الذئاب وأصحاب الندوب لمعركة قد تنهي نزاعهم طويل الأمد

1.t: Meet the Young Guns of Comedy
1.o: The hottest 20 Korean comics enter the game to assemble a diverse group of comedy characters — from Gil Eun-ji to Kwak Kyoung-young. Let the battle begin.

2.o: For their first merciless challenge, each team must come up with multiple comedy sketches within two hours. A secret vote decides who will be sent home.

3.o: Round two begins — and this time, it's a roast challenge. Can the comedians creatively master the art of an insult and win the most votes?

4.o: The roast challenge continues — with the trailing teams working hard to gain the lead. Which team will wow the audience and which will be eliminated?

5.o: Three teams remain, and the final battle of resilience begins. The rule? They must make their opponents laugh and resist laughing themselves.

6.o: The surviving contestants struggle to keep a straight face as they spare no effort to be the last team standing. Who will finally take the comedy crown?

1.o: Coming from two different backgrounds, Gong Ryong and Eve Kim embark on a space mission. But trouble strikes after launch, jeopardizing their expedition.

2.o: Upon arriving in space, Ryong panics as Eve threatens to ruin his secret mission. Shortly after, a crisis emerges, forcing Ryong to attempt a novel feat.

3.o: Determined to carry out the secret mission himself, Ryong tries to circumvent Kang Kang-su. During a space walk, Eve experiences a sudden problem.
